notes.title: Update v0.016.1 - Energon
notes.notes:
[h2]1. Redesigned Map with Rich Lore & Explorable Items[/h2]

The world of Crystal Heroes has been reimagined! Explore a stunning new map filled with diverse environments, each steeped in its own unique lore. Discover hidden items, secret locations, and unlock deeper stories as you venture through this ever-evolving world.

[h2]2. New Battle System: Energy Collection & Weapon Integration[/h2]

Combat just got a whole lot more strategic! The new battle system introduces energy collection, which is now tied directly to your weapons. Charge up your attacks and unlock powerful abilities as you gather energy during battles for a more dynamic and immersive experience.

[h2]3. No Crystal Cost for Movement in Battle[/h2]

We’ve made an important change to improve the flow of combat: moving during battles no longer consumes crystals. This allows for faster, more fluid decision-making, giving you greater freedom to maneuver and plan your next move without worrying about crystal limits.

[h2]4. Restructured Move System for Quicker Strategies[/h2]

To make battles more dynamic and tactical, we’ve restructured the move system. Expect faster, more responsive turns that let you execute your strategies with lightning speed. Now you can think on your feet and adapt more quickly than ever before.

[h2]5. Dynamic Map to Enhance Your Experience[/h2]

The map now reacts to your actions, creating a more immersive and interactive world. Expect environmental changes, surprises, and new elements that respond to your decisions and progress throughout the game, making each playthrough unique.

[h2]6. Quick Rest Option in Main UI[/h2]

Taking a break has never been easier! We’ve added a quick rest option directly in the main UI, allowing you to regain energy and prepare for the next challenge without interrupting your flow.

We hope these changes make your journey through Crystal Heroes even more thrilling and enjoyable! As always, thank you for your continued support, and we can’t wait to see what you think of the new update.

Happy adventuring, heroes!

notes.title: Update Announcement - v0.015.7
notes.notes:
Hello, Crystal Heroes community!

We’re excited to roll out our latest update, packed with significant changes and new features to enhance your gaming experience. Here’s what you can expect in the new version:

[hr][/hr]

[h2] Major Changes: [/h2]

- [b]Turn-Based Logic Revamp:[/b]  
  We’ve implemented a unit-specific turn order system! Now, units with higher dexterity will get their chance to act first, adding a new layer of strategy to your battles.

- [b]Redesigned Battle UI:[/b]  
  Our Battle User Interface has been overhauled to display more information about your units, including their equipment and consumables, allowing for more informed decisions during combat.

- [b]Separate Gem Pools:[/b]  
  Each unit now has its own gem pool instead of sharing a common one. This change will offer more tactical options and customization for your team.

- [b]Active Unit Combat:[/b]  
  Only active units can now deal damage and use skills, making positioning and unit management even more crucial.

[hr][/hr]

[h2] Minor Changes: [/h2]

- [b]Resting Mechanic:[/b]  
  You can now rest at your father's house if your unit hasn’t yet reached the town tavern, providing more opportunities for recovery.

- [b]New Dexterity Stat:[/b]  
  Introducing a new dexterity stat that scales with defense percentage, enhancing your units’ survivability in battle.

- [b]End Turn Option:[/b]  
  A new option to end your turn has been added for those moments when strategy calls for patience.

- [b]Visual Damage Indicators:[/b]  
  Get visual indication of units damage amount via gems, making combat even more engaging!

[hr][/hr]

We hope these updates enhance your experience in the world of Crystal Heroes. Thank you for your continued support, and we can’t wait to see how you utilize these changes in your strategies!

Happy gaming!

The Crystal Heroes Team

notes.title: Update Notes: v0.015.5
notes.notes:
Hey Heroes!

We’re excited to roll out our latest update for Crystal Heroes! Here’s what’s new:

1. Weapon Damage Balance:
We've adjusted weapon damage for a more balanced combat experience.

2. Quest Indicator Fix:
The pesky quest indicator in the first dungeon has been resolved!

3. Loxi's Healing Boost:
Loxi’s heal and regeneration skills are now more powerful—keep your team alive longer!

4. First Battle Tutorial:
A basic tutorial has been added to guide you through your first battle.

Thanks for your support! We hope you enjoy these improvements!

Happy adventuring,
The Crystal Heroes Team
